args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1); a second rollback completed successfully. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions (error rate ~0.002).

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all regions (error rate ~0.18).

2. **Identified the rollback target**: `v2.3.0` was the most recent version that was healthy in production.

3. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, but us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1). A second rollback completed successfully, bringing all regions to `v2.3.0`.

4. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy on `v2.3.0` in all regions (error rate ~0.002).

5. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: The `create_incident` call timed out, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that the incident was actually created — **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy", SEV2, status open) with a summary describing the rollback.
